'''House Farfalla''' was a [[Noble/Legends|noble]] house. The members of this family ruled over the [[half-Bothan]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] dwelling on their [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

[[Standard year/Legends|Years]] before the beginning of the [[Ruusan campaign]], the current [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Valenthyne Farfalla's father|Farfalla]] negotiated with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ambassador/Legends|envoy]] [[Pernicar]] and was persuaded to let his people join the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The Lord's son, [[Valenthyne Farfalla]], became a renowned [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and one of the leaders of the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]].
